name: War Song
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level bard 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a masterwork of better instrument)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area medium-range-radius spread
Duration concentration plus 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You play a song of war with the instrument used as a focus for the spell that fills your enemies with dread.

All enemies within range that can hear the song take a -2 penalty on attack rolls and saving throws.
